positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
– Create AI-Agentic flows to improve developer productivity >10% with code generation agents, code review
augmentation agents, and platform maintenance AI skills including for Project Nucleus
– Save end-users from 5+ days worth of software outages
– Lead and direct development team of engineers leveraging Agile and CI/CD best practices including
Blue/Green deployment and TDD
– Report end-user issues in under 15 minutes to on-call teams, stakeholders
– Design, architect and maintain status pages and validation processes
– Monitor and report uptime of targeted SaaS offerings against SLOs

positions.title: Design and Development Engineer
positions.description:
Accomplishments:
Researched and delivered solution for testing web-based software platform in a timely manner
Represented and informed other company employees about internally designed testing tools at internal innovation fair
Led small team (three total engineers) through entire project cycle to deliver Engineering Verification Testing on time on two separate occasions
Managed group of four persons in two month long visual verification of thermal barcode printer calibration and delivered calibrations ahead of schedule

Responsibilities:
Keyword creation for Python and Java based libraries used in Robot Framework test design
Work closely with firmware and software engineers to effectively write tests and test libraries to verify software and firmware design as each is developed
Designed Python-based test libraries for:
-Websocket connected devices
-RFID Reader/Writer devices
-Selenium-driven web testing
-Automating manual testing
Perform load testing on web platform using self-created JMeter tests
Work closely with internal customers to maintain effective testing on delivered testing procedures against released products
Design acceptance tests for automated testing of printer in an Agile design environment
Efficiently update old acceptance tests for implementation on new printer firmware
Create manual, semi-automated and automated tests for performing testing against firmware for thermal printers
Distributed, created and maintained custom Windows 7 image on several development PCs
Learn specialized languages specific to thermal printer produces (ZPL, EPL, CPCL)

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
Accomplishments:
Tracked to completion three full software releases
Attended school full time while working
Ran an average of 25 client graphical user interface test cases per day 
Set and accomplished six to ten goals per quarter which were complementary to testing work

Responsibilities:
Authored test plans, test cases and defects for client graphical user interfaces
Gained familiarity of testing video, instant messaging, and visual voicemail features
Organized and executed team test-fests uncovering additional software defects
Verified and retested all fixed defects for proper integration of software fixes
Collaborated with partners and end users to troubleshoot and solve issues with ShoreTel system through QA / Technical Assistance exchange program on a quarterly basis
Trained new team members on configuring and testing ShoreTel software and systems
Educated new team members on software platforms including Siebel Contact Center and HP Test Director.
Reviewed end user documentation for features and limitations of tested software
Provided feedback on development documentation of new features of client software before and after software implementation
Prepared and organized product  and feature demonstrations to management

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
Discussed with development possible customer interaction issues of tested software
Volunteered for testing of Corporate ShoreTel system on evenings and weekends
Gathered feedback daily from in house users of ShoreTel alpha system on 2-way video feature of client software

positions.title: Quality Assurance Test Intern
positions.description:
Responsible for authoring and executing test plans for client graphical user interface.
  Configured and maintained several ShoreTel telephony systems requiring Apple OS X and   Microsoft Windows installations necessitating familiarity with Norton ghosting software and VMWare

positions.title: Manager
positions.description:
Accomplishments:
Oversaw operations of 15 employees serving up to 12000 customers a week
Received award for excellence in customer service based on a third party review
Developed skills for solving a wide variety of customer issues in a timely and fair manner

Responsibilities:
   Spliced, assembled, projected and disassembled films for viewing by customers
   Counted and verified hourly bank deposits of cash
   Maintained and verified twice daily amounts kept in petty cash safes
   Solved wide-ranging customer service issues in a fast and friendly manner

positions.title: Concession Attendant / Box Office Attendant
positions.description:
Interacted with hundreds of different customers in a consistent friendly and effective     manner
 Operated cash register

Software Tools:
Robot Framework, PyCharm, HP Test Director, Siebel Contact Center, Microsoft Office, Norton Ghost, VMWare, Eclipse, Open GL, GLUT, GLUI, Dev-C++, Xcode, 

Operating Systems:
Windows (XP, Vista, 7, 8), OS X, iOS

Languages:
Python, Java, C, C++
